subject: gk
question:
Which of the following figures accurately depicts the inter-conversion of the three states of matter?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/563b9c6c6635f93232d56d276815a961bb19822f8a4fbc38de1b95acfd55c116.png]
solution:
The correct answer is __**b**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Fusion **(Melting): The process of changing from solid to liquid.
 
• **Solidification **(Freezing): The process of changing from liquid to solid.
 
• **Vaporization **(Boiling/Evaporation): The process of changing from liquid to gas.
 
• **Condensation**: The process of changing from gas to liquid.
 
• **Sublimation**: The process of changing directly from solid to gas without passing through the liquid state.
 
• **Deposition**: The process of changing directly from gas to solid without passing through the liquid state.
 
• Hence, figure (b) correctly shows all these processes connecting the states of matter. The other figures have incorrect or missing arrows depicting these processes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/162ad1f11687139adc219755d084ecbb009072b9f9ac1bec4a8dad8c7fc8db51.png]
